questions.question: When Joseph was serving Potiphar in Egypt and became a successful man, who was with him?
When Potiphar's wife asked Joseph to sleep with her, what did Joseph say doing it would be?

answers.text: A great evil and a sin against God
A great shame and a disgrace before Egypt
A great folly and a dishonor to his father

questions.question: After Potiphar heard his wife's false story about Joseph, what did Potiphar do with Joseph?

answers.text: Had him thrown into the king's prison
Sent him to work in the fields

questions.question: While Joseph was in prison in Egypt, what did the prison warden do with him?

answers.text: Put all the prisoners in his care
Let him walk out a free man
Sent him back to Potiphar's house
